notes.title: Amber City is released！
notes.content:
Our new game Amber City  is now available on Steam thanks to your company and support! You can get -10% discount for the game in the first week.

Like Flood of Light, Amber City will bring you well-designed puzzles. What's more in Amber City, we designed dozens of creative mechanics and optimized gameplay experience. We hope both casual and hardcore gamers can enjoy the game in a more convenient way. 

A girl in a white dress wakes up in a ruined city. What happened to her? It's up to you to find out!

In additive to Flood of Light being half price, we also offer you four different bundles with extra discounts. Maybe you could find the best option for you.

notes.title: Amber City will launch on September 1st
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Long time no see, we've been improving and optimizing Amber City since the release of demo, and now I am glad to say that Amber City, along with OST and artbook, will be released on September 1st. You can get -10% discount for the game in the first week.

Meanwhile Flood of Light, our previous title, will be 50% off from September 1st. You can even get another -10% discount if you buy the bundle! Check the picture below for more informtion.

notes.title: Have You Played Flood of Light?
notes.content:
Have You Played? is an endless stream of game retrospectives. One a day, every day, perhaps for all time.

I like little games you can jump in and out of, or play all in one go, and Flood of Light is one of those. It s a hand-drawn, 2D, adventure puzzle game. And if you know me, you know I love puzzle games. You play a small girl in a big raincoat, called “The Guide”, left in a city that is submerged in water. It looks like it s been a British summer – loads of rain. It s your job to help save the place by using light, alongside some little microwaves on legs (robots) that inhabit the city. As you go, you learn who The Guide really is, through small snippets of story played out through emails.
